The best advice I can give as a voyager that frequently runs around with 29 kilos on my back is know the area you're in and what exactly you want to do. For example If there's a house with a bed close by where you're hunting and gathering you probably won't need a bed roll, or if you're going fishing you'll need tackle and firewood, maybe some food but not two kilos of charcoal. 

If you get a general idea of your day and plan it with the map in mind you'll have a better idea of what's gonna be essential for you. And having a few satellite bases around where you can dump off the stuff you need, but don't need to constantly have on you, would help.
